latest_release.name: v3.2.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

Hello everyone! Today, we’re releasing another update to Harper, the grammar checker designed to get out of your way. Since our last release, we’ve been focused almost entirely on fixing some pretty critical bugs. 

In our Desktop app, we’ve resolved some problems with memory management when your Mac went to sleep. You should no longer see “Out of Memory” error messages after you wake your Mac up in the morning. We've also fixed some pretty horrendous problems with our setup process. It should now be far more intuitive. We hope to make it prettier in the future, too.

In our Chrome Extension, we paid special attention to our users who write in Ellipsus or in WordPress’ Gutenberg editor. Suggestions and highlights should now start ending up in the right places.

Finally, as with all our releases, we made some miscellaneous improvements to our core grammar engine. 

Hope you all have a great weekend, Elijah.

## The PRs We've Merged

* fix(core): TheyToThem no longer flags "the help they received" by @jayhemnani9910 in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4856
* feat: no-to-little → little-to-no by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4857
* fix(linting): don't join "out guesses" to "outguesses" by @Yi-111-a in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4863
* docs: GitHub issue template for false negatives by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4867
* feat: come acrossed/acrost/acrosst → come across by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4782
* fix(core): mark "later" and "further" as adverbs by @jayhemnani9910 in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4868
* fix(core): don't flag spelling inside known proper nouns by @GaryJones in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4838
* fix(ci): upgrade Playwright by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4902
* fix(desktop): memory leak when the device goes to sleep by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4905
* fix(lint-framework): keep popup styles on pages with a strict style-src by @braklo in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4821
* fix(chrome-ext): handle a reset user dictionary by @GaryJones in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4827
* feat: look forwards to → look forward to by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4885
* refactor: simplify spellcheck logic for easier reasoning by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4870
* feat: if I where to → if I were to by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4873
* feat: moment(s) of truths → moments of truth by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4894
* fix(chrome-ext): Ellipsus suggestion application problems by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4906
* feat: scared about → scared of by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4895
* feat: besides for → besides/except for/other than by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4915
* feat: by hands → by hand by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4842
* feat: spare no expenses→spare no expense by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4872
* fix: tokenizing non-ascii latin letters after an 's' by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4881
* feat: make the most out of→make the most of by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4882
* feat: in threat → under threat by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4893
* fix(desktop): update indication and add link to system settings by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4928
* test(chrome-ext): run Typst editor tests against a local CodeMirror page by @GaryJones in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4924
* fix(core): accept British -ise and -yse forms by @GaryJones in https://github.com/Autom
